ruleDefinitions.name: Regsvr32 Execution From Highly Suspicious Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of regsvr32 where the DLL is located in a highly suspicious locations

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "REGSVR32\.EXE") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\PerfLogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Registration\\\\CRMLog.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\com\\\\dmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\FxsTmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Microsoft\\\\Crypto\\\\RSA\\\\MachineKeys\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\drivers\\\\color\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\PRINTERS\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\spool\\\\SERVERS\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\_Migrated\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SyncCenter\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\com\\\\dmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\FxsTmp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\PLA\\\\System\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\Tasks\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\\\SyncCenter\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Tasks\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Tracing\\\\.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"C\\:\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'C\\:\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*D\\:\\\\.*")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\ProgramData\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\"C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\'C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\.*"))))) AND  NOT (process_command_line = "" OR process_command_line = "None")
